component.name: rufus-linux
component.summary: Create bootable USB drives the Rufus way — natively on Linux

description.p: rufus-linux is a from-scratch Rust rewrite of Rufus with a self-contained Win32-style GUI: pick a device, pick an ISO and press START.

ul.li: Disk or ISO image, raw/DD, non-bootable, FreeDOS and Windows To Go write modes
MBR and GPT partitioning, UEFI:NTFS, old-BIOS fixes, bad-blocks check
Official Windows and Linux ISO downloads with SHA-256 verification
38-language interface with OpenType shaping and bidi reordering
Five write modes incl. Windows To Go with Rufus-exact boot layouts
In-app official ISO downloads (Windows 11/10 + 8 Linux distros)
38-language UI, bad-blocks check, persistence, image hashes
